text: Levodopa is the principal pharmacological approach for troublesome Parkinsonian tremor; it can improve both resting and action tremor, although individual response varies. (medium confidence)

text: The tremor review states that underdosing of levodopa or non-adherence are important causes of poor tremor control in clinical practice, and that impaired swallowing, altered gastric motility and bacterial overgrowth leading to impaired levodopa absorption may contribute to levodopa pseudoresistance. (medium confidence)

text: For residual tremor, anticholinergics have only a restricted role in young cognitively intact patients, propranolol has limited supporting evidence, and clozapine may help but requires specialist safety monitoring because of serious adverse effects. (medium confidence)
keywords: Tremor, gait, freezing and postural instability management

text: Freezing treatment studies are difficult to compare when they omit subtype classification or rely on a single rating-scale item; identifying the freezing phenotype and measuring freezing directly are important to interpretation. (medium confidence)
keywords: Tremor, gait, freezing and postural instability management

text: The methylphenidate gait trial report states that dopaminergic treatments and currently available surgical therapies are often insufficiently effective for gait disorders in PD, and NICE NG71 recommends offering Parkinson's disease-specific physiotherapy for people experiencing balance or motor function problems. (medium confidence)
keywords: Tremor, gait, freezing and postural instability management

text: ReSPonD was a phase 2 trial in people with Parkinson disease who had fallen, could walk unaided and did not have dementia: rivastigmine improved step-time variability during normal walking and a simple dual task, but not the complex dual task, and caused more gastrointestinal adverse effects. (low confidence)
keywords: Tremor, gait, freezing and postural instability management

text: Disabling tremor that persists despite optimized medication can justify specialist assessment for invasive treatment, including deep brain stimulation; the tremor review also identifies focused ultrasound as an option. (medium confidence)
keywords: Tremor, gait, freezing and postural instability management

text: Freezing is heterogeneous: OFF freezing usually improves with dopaminergic treatment, pseudo-ON freezing can improve with additional dopamine, and true ON freezing can be induced by dopaminergic stimulation; these categories should not be assumed to respond identically. (low confidence)
keywords: Tremor, gait, freezing and postural instability management

text: For OFF-related freezing, reducing OFF time through individualized dopaminergic treatment is a first-line approach; the German guideline recommends levodopa for symptomatic freezing treatment. (medium confidence)
keywords: Tremor, gait, freezing and postural instability management

text: The ReSPonD investigators interpreted rivastigmine as potentially improving gait stability and possibly reducing falls, and explicitly called for phase 3 confirmation. (medium confidence)
keywords: Tremor, gait, freezing and postural instability management

text: In the Espay randomized crossover trial, methylphenidate did not improve gait and tended to worsen motor function, sleepiness and quality of life; this negative trial limits extrapolation from positive open-label observations. (medium confidence)
keywords: Tremor, gait, freezing and postural instability management

text: The German consensus guideline allows methylphenidate to be considered for freezing, whereas the Espay trial authors report no gait benefit and a tendency toward worse outcomes; this is a difference between a permissive recommendation and a negative trial in a specific population. (medium confidence)
keywords: Tremor, gait, freezing and postural instability management
